title: ک شاخه گل (Yek Shakhe Gol)
field_description: Collection consists of broadcasts of the radio programme Yek Shakhe Gol (or Yik shakh-i gol). Translated as 'A Bouquet of Roses [of Song and Verse],' the radio programme was produced by Davoud Pirnia as part of The Golha (‘Flowers of Persian Song and Music’) radio programmes which was broadcast on Iranian National Radio between 1956 and 1979. Out of 465 programmes produced, 420 digitized copies are available in this collection.

title: رانه‌ها و خاطره‌ها (Taraneha ve Khatereha)
field_description: Collection consists of broadcasts of the radio programme Taraneha ve Khatereha, a radio programme produced by Davoud Pirnia as part of The Golha (‘Flowers of Persian Song and Music’) radio programmes that were broadcast on Iranian National Radio between 1956 and 1979.

title: مجموعه برنامه برگ سبز (Barg-e-Shabz)
field_description: Collection consists of radio broadcasts of Barg-e-Shabz (Barg-i sabz). Translated as 'A Green Leaf [of Song and Verse]’, the series was produced by Davoud Pirnia as part of The Golha (‘Flowers of Persian Song and Music’) radio programmes broadcast on Iranian National Radio between 1956 and 1979. Out of 312 programmes produced, 297 digitized copies are available in this collection.

title: گلهای صحرایی (Golhaye Sahrai)
field_description: Collection consists of radio broadcasts of Golhaye Sahrai (Golha-yi ṣaḥra’i). Translated as 'Desert Flowers [of Song and Verse]’, the series was produced by Davoud Pirnia as part of The Golha (‘Flowers of Persian Song and Music’) radio programmes broadcast on Iranian National Radio between 1956 and 1979. Out of 64 programmes produced, 44 digitized copies are available in this collection.

title: گلهای تازه (Golhaye Tazeh)
field_description: Collection consists of radio broadcasts of Golhaye Taszeh (Golha-yi tazeh). Translated as 'Fresh Flowers [of Song and Verse],' the series was produced by Hushang Ibtihaj (Sayeh), a well-known modern Persian poet, and broadcast on Iranian National Radio. Out of 201 programmes produced, 167 digitized copies are available in this collection.

title: رنامه گلهای رنگارنگ (Golhaye Rangarang)
field_description: Collection consists of radio broadcasts of Golhaye Rangarang (Golha-yi rangarang). Translated as ‘Particoloured Flowers [of Persian Poetry and Song]’, the series was produced by Davoud Pirnia as part of The Golha (‘Flowers of Persian Song and Music’) radio programmes that were broadcast on Iranian National Radio between 1956 and 1979. Out of 481 programmes produced, 407 digitized copies are available in this collection.
